summary: Read a list of positive integers and a target k. The list length is from 1 to 105, and every entry as well as k lies between 1 and 109. In one step, choose two entries that add up to k and delete both of them. A single entry may be used only once. Find the largest number of such steps that can be carried out and write that count.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
